description: This Java class 'DatatableUtil' provides utility methods for handling data tables within the Fineract platform, including validation, data retrieval, and data scoping based on user permissions and entity types.

classes.name: DatatableUtil
classes.description: Utility service class for managing data tables, including validation, data retrieval, and data scoping within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: isMultirowDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the data table supports multiple rows based on column headers.

methods.name: getFKField
methods.description: Retrieves the foreign key column name for a given entity table.

methods.name: validateDatatableRegistered
methods.description: Validates that a data table is registered in the system.

methods.name: validateDatatableName
methods.description: Validates the format and correctness of a data table name.

methods.name: resolveEntity
methods.description: Resolves an entity name to its EntityTables enum, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: queryForApplicationEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the application table entity for a given registered data table.

methods.name: checkMainResourceExistsWithinScope
methods.description: Checks if the main resource exists within the user's data scope and returns relevant identifiers.

methods.name: dataScopedSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for data scoping based on entity type and user hierarchy.

methods.name: getOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Constructs SQL join condition for office hierarchy filtering.

methods.name: getGroupOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Constructs SQL join condition for group hierarchy filtering.

methods.name: getClientOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Constructs SQL join condition for client hierarchy filtering.

methods.name: retrieveDataTableGenericResultSet
methods.description: Retrieves a generic result set for a data table, with optional filtering and ordering.
